strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill threejs-gltf-loading，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when a model is invisible or tiny, decoder files 404, animations never play, or clones share one skeleton.
Workflow: Inspect the file before writing loader code; Load with `GLTFLoader`; Add `gltf.scene` and frame it; One `AnimationMixer` per animated root.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：threejs-scene-setup 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_scene_setup_v1，threejs-materials-lighting 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_materials_lighting_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
